universal_lens: Evidence-driven ancestral lineage mapping via probabilistic graph kernels over multi-generational genealogical chains. Genealogical data reconciliation under uncertainty using Bayesian belief nets with probabilistic identity merging. gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief propagation across ancestral nodes using conditional probability tables derived from record-level corroboration. GSI employs conformal predictive inference to map conflicting ancestral claims into posterior probability distributions over identity variants.
gse_mapping: Situationally adaptive state transitions in genealogical research paths guided by confidence thresholds and empirical observables. GSE models genealogical evolution as a Markov decision process with state transitions governed by documentary evidence likelihoods.
